descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S13 「不是你的病历：不列出、用 URL 打不开、改不了，也伪造不了对它的访问记录」 A chart that is not yours: not listed, not reachable by URL, not changeable, and no access row can be forged against it

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Every patient access is recorded in the audit log and attributed to the signed-in physician. Each row has the patient, the physician, a timestamp and the action (view / save / generate / handoff send …（UAT OAT-01 step 5；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 7；TFA-94513 AC 12；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U6 Open sign-up: a new email that was never invited signs in with the emailed code. The physician is created and appears in the physician list.（UAT OAT-01 step 6；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 13） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • T4 App review accounts: exactly two designated emails (appconnect-test-account@roundcompanion.com, playstore-test-account@roundcompanion.com) accept a fixed, reusable code that never expires. …（TFA-94513 AC 15；TFA-94513 AC 16；UAT OAT-01 Expected） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Two physicians, each with their own patients in Hospital, clinic and Nursing Home; a signed-in physician and the id of a chart they do not own or that was deleted

When Physician B lists and reads physician A's rounding patient, opens it by URL in the browser, and tries to update and delete it; B does the same for clinic and SNF panels; B calls access.logChartAccess with a chart id B does not own.

Then B's list never shows A's patient, the URL shows no chart, reads return nothing, and updates and deletes are refused and change nothing, in every panel. No PHI_READ row is written for an id B does not own.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：api/isolation.spec.ts, chromium isolation.spec.ts and api/audit.spec.ts assertions. Judged against U6 (open sign-up lets anyone in, so a new account must not see another physician's patients), T4 (an account sees only its own patients, in both modes; …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
